title: Finite-output cohomology in the constant coefficient presentation
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be a finite field extension, and use its valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$ and chosen uniformizer $\varpi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Use the associated adic coefficient datum $d=(R,(\varpi))$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], its function-coefficient sheaves $R_{n,W}$ for $R/(\varpi^{n+1})$, and its canonical constant-to-function comparison $c_{W,n}:\underline{R/(\varpi^{n+1})}_W\xrightarrow{\sim}R_{n,W}$ [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]. For every scheme $W$, $n\in\mathbf N$, $J\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(R_{n,W}))$, and $i\in\mathbf Z$, define the finite-output cohomology in the constant presentation to be $\operatorname{Res}_{c_{W,n}}\mathcal H^i(J)$, using cohomology sheaves [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves] and the restriction-of-scalars functor of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]. This is a definition for all $J$ and $i$, with no boundedness, constructibility, completeness or etale-origin assumption.
